description: This PHP source file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Wisdom Service API. It includes method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, and retrieving resources such as assistants, content, knowledge bases, and sessions. The class extends from AwsClient, indicating it leverages the AWS SDK infrastructure.

classes.name: ConnectWisdomServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Wisdom Service API, providing methods for resource management and operations as defined by the AWS SDK.

methods.name: createAssistant
methods.description: Creates a new assistant in the Wisdom Service.

methods.name: Other Methods
methods.description: Additional methods for managing resources such as associations, knowledge bases, QuickResponses, sessions, tags, and import jobs, both synchronously and asynchronously.
